name_en: Ackermann quantifier elimination for Presburger arithmetic
canonical_claim: In a source-specified quantifier-elimination language for Presburger arithmetic interpreted on the natural numbers, every first-order formula is equivalent, with the same free variables and uniformly over assignments, to a quantifier-free formula produced or characterized by the source-specified Ackermann elimination result.

canonical_formal_target.environment_fingerprint: Lean 4.29.0@98dc76e3; mathlib@8a178386; intake API probe only

domain_and_universes: Expected standard structure Nat and finite or arbitrary free-variable types; exact language expansion and theory/model boundary are open pending source review.
quantifiers: Expected universal quantification over formulas and assignments, followed by existence or algorithmic production of a quantifier-free equivalent; binder order and parameter treatment are open.
hypotheses: Expected interpretation in the standard natural-number Presburger structure or models of a source-specified complete theory; exact choice is open.
conclusion: A quantifier-free formula in the same specified language is semantically equivalent to the input formula, or an elimination procedure returns one and is proved correct.

alternate_encodings.target: semilinear-set characterization of Presburger-definable subsets of finite powers of Nat
alternate_encodings.relationship: related semantic characterization, not accepted as the quantifier-elimination root without checked transports and a source match

alternate_encodings.target: decision procedure or decidability of Presburger arithmetic
alternate_encodings.relationship: consequence or neighboring result, not a substitute for quantifier elimination

excluded_degenerate_cases: No silent replacement by semilinear definability, decidability, a single formula, or the false bare-language QE claim. Closed sentences, zero free variables, equality atoms, and parameter conventions must be handled explicitly by the selected statement.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical logic and choice requirements of the eventual syntax transformation and semantic proof remain open
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib 8a178386; IntakeProbe elaboration only; exact import and proof dependency closure open
computation_profile: A constructive syntax transformation may be intended, but no algorithm, termination argument, evaluator, oracle, or certificate receives credit at intake
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source edition, language, theory/standard-model boundary, canonical wording, Lean target, toolchain, mathlib pin, profile, schema, or validator change; independent review remains open.
